subject: Re: Invoice INV-001
body: Thank you for the invoice. We will process payment by end of this week.

subject: Payment for INV-009
body: Hi team we have transferred the full amount of INV-009 to your account today. Please confirm receipt.

subject: Re: Outstanding Invoice INV-010
body: We acknowledge the invoice. Our accounts team is processing this. Expect payment by April 5th.

subject: Invoice INV-012 - Query
body: The invoice amount seems incorrect. We had agreed on a rate of 270000 not 285000. Please clarify before we process payment.

subject: Re: Reminder INV-022
body: We are aware of the outstanding amount for INV-022. We are going through a temporary cash flow constraint. Can we arrange to pay this over 2 monthly installments?

subject: Payment processed INV-023
body: Dear team payment of Rs 310000 has been processed via RTGS today for invoice INV-023. Reference: REF-MTR-023.

subject: Re: Invoice INV-021
body: We confirm receipt of invoice INV-021. Payment will be made by April 25th.

subject: Dispute on INV-018
body: There is a discrepancy in invoice INV-018. The quantity billed is 500 units but we only received 470 units. We will pay for 470 units only. Please issue a revised invoice.

subject: INV-012 resolved
body: We have reviewed the contract. You are right the amount of 285000 is correct as per the revised order. Payment will be processed within the week.

subject: INV-022 payment plan
body: Further to our earlier email we propose paying INV-022 in two parts: 190000 by June 1st and 190000 by July 1st. Please confirm if this is acceptable.

subject: Re: Invoice INV-034
body: Hi the invoice INV-034 is under review by our finance head. We will confirm payment by June 10th.

subject: Out of Office
body: I am out of the office until June 3rd. For urgent matters please contact rajesh@acmeconstruction.com. I will respond on my return.

subject: INV-018 - revised invoice requested
body: Following our previous email please send a revised invoice for 470 units. We cannot process payment until we receive the corrected invoice.

subject: Re: Second reminder INV-035
body: We will make the payment for INV-035 by July 8th. We apologize for the delay.

subject: INV-047 - payment timeline
body: Dear team INV-047 for infrastructure milestone 4 is on our payment schedule. We will process payment by July 25th.

subject: Payment INV-048
body: Please be informed that payment of Rs 298000 for INV-048 has been initiated. It should reflect in your account within 2 working days.

subject: INV-046 payment
body: We confirm payment of INV-046 has been processed today. Transaction reference REF-SUN-046.

subject: Re: INV-059 reminder
body: The payment for INV-059 is scheduled for next week. Our CFO has approved the payment run.

subject: INV-058 payment delay
body: We are currently awaiting release of export proceeds from customs. This is causing a delay. We expect to clear INV-058 by September 8th.

subject: Re: Overdue notice INV-073
body: Payment for INV-073 will be made by September 28th. We are currently finalizing our monthly payment run.

subject: INV-070 - cashflow issue
body: We are experiencing significant delays in receiving payments from our overseas buyers. We request an extension of 30 days on INV-070. We will pay by October 25th.

subject: INV-075 payment
body: Payment for INV-075 has been approved by our board. Processing date is November 5th.

subject: INV-076 - dispute
body: We have identified that INV-076 includes charges for services not yet delivered. Specifically items 3 and 4 on the invoice were scheduled for Q4 delivery. We dispute the full amount and request a revised invoice.

subject: INV-090 query
body: We are reviewing INV-090 internally. Could you confirm the scope of work covered in this invoice? We want to ensure it aligns with milestone acceptance criteria before processing.

subject: Re: INV-091 - payment schedule
body: Regarding INV-091 we propose the following: 300000 by February 28th and the balance 280000 by March 31st. Please confirm acceptance.

subject: INV-097 - will pay next week
body: Hi team. Payment for INV-097 is being processed. It will be done by March 7th.

subject: INV-098 payment confirmation
body: We have sent payment for INV-098 today via NEFT. Please confirm receipt.

subject: INV-099 dispute - pricing error
body: The unit price on INV-099 does not match our purchase order PO-2025-003. The PO has a rate of 3800 per unit not 4000. Please correct and reissue.

subject: INV-100 - approval pending
body: INV-100 is currently pending board approval for payment. Our next board meeting is March 28th after which we will process this.

subject: Re: overdue notice INV-096
body: We acknowledge this invoice is overdue. We are currently in dispute with our freight partner which has delayed our receivables. We will update you by March 20th.
